name: Project Logs and Project Reports
one_liner: Domain-specific risks, issues, decisions and changes — logged, then reported upward.
purpose: To enable overall monitoring of project performance during Executing, the A-PCT documents and manages its domain-specific risks, issues, decisions and changes, using the PM² management plans and artefacts as the starting point. Managing these logs lets the Project Core Team spot items that affect overall project performance, supports the PM's reporting and forecasting, and gives the PM the coordination tool for assigning items back to the A-PCT. The development aspect then contributes its status and progress information to the project's reports: the Project Status Report carries the Development Status Report, and the Project Progress Report gives a high-level overview of the whole project.
